recentItems.title: How Do We Stop a Bender's Abilities? | Braving the Elements | Avatar
recentItems.description:
The technique of Chi-Blocking has evolved so much throughout the Avatar series. Director and main character designer Joaquim Dos Santos discusses how Chi-Blocking was the first example of physical connection in a series about bending the elements, while still being something very delicate and precise. From Ty Lee to Amon nearly seventy years later... Chi-Blocking has become all the more powerful!
